title: C05 'They finally wrote back': connect when there is a cue, clarify when there is not
capability: Two things are awaiting an answer: a pottery submission from over three months ago and a job application from this week. A bare 'I finally got a reply' with no cue cannot be attributed, so a light clarification is right and neither guessing the recent one nor asking for the whole story again is. Two days later, after talk of throwing pots and a letter arriving by post, the same kind of sentence does have a cue and should be connected to the old submission.

allowed.statement: Both a juried pottery entry and an application to a local records office are waiting for an answer.
The letter is about the three ash-glazed bowls entered in the juried show, whose results were due by post in autumn.

forbidden.statement: Taking the bare announcement to be about the records office post without checking.
Taking the bare announcement to be about the pottery entry without checking.
Asking the person to explain from the beginning what they had applied or entered for.
Connecting the letter on the doormat to the records office post despite the pottery context and the postal cue.
Stating or implying whether the entry was accepted; the outcome has not been said.

expectedBehavior: Bare announcement: share the excitement and ask which one, naming both in a few words.
Cued announcement: recognise it as the show's answer and ask how it went, without inventing the outcome.
Never ask for the back story again.
failureSignals: The old submission never reaches the Provider when the cue points at it.
The bare announcement is silently attributed to the most recent matter.
The cued announcement still triggers a clarification or is attributed to the job.

sourceEligibility.reason: Retained original expression; relevant earlier background is not limited to seven days.
Retained original expression; carries the 'by post in autumn' cue.
Recent and inside the default background.
Recent and inside the default background.

criteria.description: The bare announcement streams and commits.
The recent pending matter reaches the Provider for the bare announcement.
The older pending matter also reaches the Provider, otherwise the ambiguity cannot even be seen.
With a pottery and postal cue, the three-month-old submission reaches the Provider.
What was said a moment earlier in the same conversation reaches the Provider.
Without a cue: a light clarification that names both, no guess and no request to retell.
With a cue: connected to the old submission, outcome not invented.
